claim: A publication packet rejected by publicationBoundary.v1 cannot invoke a static renderer or Worker renderer through publicationEnforcement.v1; accepted Worker responses receive mandatory runtime security headers that renderer output cannot weaken.

verification.command: node --test publicationEnforcement.v1.test.mjs against byte-identical local files
verification.adversarial_finding: The first test implementation exposed that renderer headers could override mandatory noindex and no-store values. The merge order was corrected and the suite rerun successfully.

boundaries.privacy_scope: Structured packet fields and repository-safe implementation only; no private source material processed.

limits: The gate is not yet wired into a deployed Cloudflare Worker or static build pipeline.
The structured assessor does not provide general prose de-identification or clinical validation.
Runtime behavior is proven by deterministic Node tests, not by a live Cloudflare request.
falsification_route: Import the module in an authenticated checkout, run the retained tests, then attempt a rejected packet through both adapters and verify neither renderer is called; for deployment evidence, wire the adapter into the Worker/build path and retain exact-commit request results.
